record.what_it_does: All-in-one CRM, marketing automation and white-label agency platform for agencies and SMBs.
record.auth_notes: API v2 supports two methods. The first is OAuth 2.0 through a Marketplace app; it is needed for public integrations, webhooks and custom modules. The second is the Private Integration Token (PIT), a static bearer token for internal use on one sub-account at a time. HighLevel's help center says the legacy API v1 keys have reached end-of-support. The vendor's MCP server uses a HighLevel login with no API key, but the docs page does not name the protocol.
record.access_notes: The Marketplace developer portal has self-serve signup (email and phone verification), and the developer account gets sandbox accounts for testing. Private apps are not listed and are meant for development and testing. Listing a public app requires submitting it for approval: "all apps go through a rigorous review process before getting listed." A Loom demo is required at submission. End users need a paid HighLevel plan: the help center says API access, including OAuth and PIT, is on Starter, Unlimited and Founder (formerly Agency Pro), and some endpoints require Founder. I could not confirm whether the developer account itself costs anything.
record.api_breadth_notes: API v2 covers contacts, opportunities, calendars, conversations, invoices, payments, products, locations, users, social planner, workflows and more. The vendor's MCP docs say 717 actions are available to a connection.
record.mcp_notes: Vendor-hosted at https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2 for Claude. Other clients have their own paths: /mcp/openai/v2/, /mcp/cursor/v2 and /mcp/muse/v2/. The server has 4 meta-tools (list_locations, search_operations, describe_operation, execute_operation) that reach 717 actions. Users sign in with their HighLevel login, with no API key.
record.blocker_notes: A toolkit used by many agencies needs a public Marketplace OAuth app, and public listing requires review and approval, including a Loom demo and justification for each requested scope. Development and testing are self-serve through a private app plus a sandbox account, which lasts up to 6 months. End users need a paid HighLevel plan, and some endpoints require the Founder plan.

We offer a comprehensive set of webhook events that cover all major activities in our platform.
Markdown and OpenAPI-based documentation for easy readability and automation.
all apps go through a rigorous review process before getting listed
Both OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens (PIT) are available across plans.
A Sandbox account remains active for up to 6 months from the creation date.
A Loom demo is required as the final step in the app submission flow.

record.needs_human: Two things are unconfirmed. First, whether signing up for a Marketplace developer account is free and needs no HighLevel subscription; the docs describe signup but give no price. Second, whether the GitHub repo's apps/ folder holds the OpenAPI JSON files; the repo describes itself as OpenAPI-based, but I did not list the folder's contents.
